content.text: Ticket t009 is an urgent account ticket. The customer reports a login alert from a city they have never visited and two notebooks shared with an unrecognized address, and the ticket has no other details. I could not pull the account's login history or the notebook sharing history, because my tools only read tickets and cannot query account activity. A search for related tickets returned no other reports of this issue.
